title: ulmus carpinifolia var. suberosa
intro: Ulmus carpinifolia var. suberosa, commonly known as Cork Elm, is a deciduous tree species within the elm family (Ulmaceae) that is native to Eastern Europe and Asia. This plant has been utilized in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cardiovascular diseases and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Ulmus carpinifolia var. suberosa include immune system modulation and antimicrobial activity, which may aid in the treatment of infections and wounds. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
